title: AccountHolderIndividualResponse
description: Information about an individual associated with an account holder. A subset of the information provided via KYC. For example, we do not return the government id.

dob.description: Individual's date of birth, as an RFC 3339 date.

first_name.description: Individual's first name, as it appears on government-issued identity documents.

last_name.description: Individual's last name, as it appears on government-issued identity documents.

phone_number.description: Individual's phone number, entered in E.164 format.

entity_token.description: Globally unique identifier for the entity.
